title: Issuing Resort Credit on a Granite Ridge Season Pass That Has Been Given Up
content:
## When this facility applies

Where a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass has been given up, the collective returns value to the household as resort credit issued against that pass record. The resort credit issued when a pass is given up is worked out only after the pass account carries the charge retained on the pass being given up. The figure issued is the one the collective's basis for settlement credit produces; the agent works it out from the records and the published terms and passes it in.

## The business effect

The credit is booked on the pass account dated today and the resort credit standing on that pass record rises by the same figure, so the household can spend it across the collective within the tier's validity.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the hidden agent tool `issue_settlement_credit_d3237287` and then calls it. It is an agent-side tool and is not handed to the guest.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pass_id` | the reference number of the season pass record the credit is issued against | an identifier, as returned by the season pass lookup |
| `protection_plan_id` | the reference number of the protection plan record the collective checks the settlement against | an identifier, as returned by the protection plan lookup; it is recorded with the credit and the plan itself is left untouched |
| `settlement_credit_usd` | the resort credit issued to the household | a fixed-format figure in USD to 2 decimal places, never negative and booked at exactly the figure given |

No parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the new pass account entry reference, a string beginning `pstl_`, the pass record reference, the credit issued in USD to 2 decimal places and the resort credit standing on that pass record afterwards, also in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the credit was issued.

## Contract questions

*What must the pass account carry before the credit is worked out?* The charge retained on the pass being given up; the figure is worked out only after that charge stands on the account.

*Is the protection plan changed by this call?* No. The plan reference is recorded with the credit and the plan itself is left untouched.
